description.en: Small tools for development, starting with JSON: format, minify, escape, a tree to browse and search names and values. Finds JSON inside log lines, escaped JSON and one-per-line JSON. Type json and a space for the JSON on the clipboard, or paste JSON straight into the search box; right-click a .json file for View in JSON tool.
description.zh: 给开发的小工具，先有 JSON：格式化、压缩、转义，树形查看，搜索键名和值。日志里夹着的、转义过的、一行一段的 JSON 都能认出来。搜索框输入 json 加空格看剪贴板里的 JSON，也可以直接把 JSON 粘贴进搜索框；.json 文件右键「用 JSON 工具查看」。

notes.zh: 窗口用上了 Win顺 0.52.0 更省内存的界面零件：一个图标从五个对象变成一个，焦点框、开关的光晕、按钮尾巴上的图标这些平时看不到的部分第一次要用时才做出来。Windows 内存用到 70% 以上时，闲着时照样把内存让出来；以前到 80% 就一点都不还（#500）。权限不变。
notes.en: Its windows use the lighter controls of WinShun 0.52.0: an icon is one object instead of five, and parts hardly ever shown (focus rings, a switch's glow, a button's trailing icon) are made the first time they are wanted. With 70 % or more of the memory in use it gives its memory back while idle all the same; from 80 % it used to give nothing back (#500). Permissions unchanged.
